scripts.check:audit: astro build --verbose 2>&1 | tee build.log && echo 'Lines of CSS:' && find dist/ -name '*.css' -exec wc -c {} + 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || echo 'CSS inlined in HTML' && echo 'Total JS:' && find dist/ -name '*.js' -exec wc -c {} + 2>/dev/null | tail -1 && echo 'Total dist:' && du -sh dist/
